key_insight: Jointly optimizing charging schedules and bus operations while accounting for dynamic electricity prices and grid constraints cuts operating cost and improves service reliability for mixed electric/diesel transit fleets.
problem_solved: Determines when and where to charge electric buses and how to assign vehicles to routes under time-varying electricity prices and grid limits, ensuring service requirements are met while minimizing cost and grid impact.
method: Formulate a grid-aware operational optimization that jointly assigns charging slots and route duties for a mixed fleet (mixed-integer/convex program).
Incorporate dynamic electricity pricing and grid capacity constraints via scenario-aware or rolling-horizon decision making to handle temporal uncertainty.
Validate with realistic transit and grid data and compare against baseline heuristics to quantify cost, energy, and service benefits.
impact: Provides a practical optimization framework AI/ML practitioners can pair with forecasting or learning modules (price, demand, battery degradation) to build hybrid model-based/data-driven operational systems that reduce costs and emissions.
visual_elements: Time-series chart: dynamic electricity price over a day with overlaid charging schedule per bus (showing load shifting).
Map/route diagram: transit network with vehicle assignments and charging-station usage highlighted.
Pipeline flowchart: inputs (forecasts, fleet/state, grid limits) → optimizer → operational schedule and charging plan.
Before/after bar chart: cost, energy consumption, and service metrics comparing optimized policy to baseline.
paper_title: Grid-Aware Charging and Operational Optimization for Mixed-Fleet Public Transit
paper_authors: Rishav Sen, Amutheezan Sivagnanam, Aron Laszka, Ayan Mukhopadhyay, Abhishek Dubey
